answer: An agent market for violet dye trading, reef monitoring, and fable editing requires every bidding identity to lock a $100 bond for 30 days, with one live bid per bond. Creating accounts is cheap, but flooding the market with 10,000 simultaneous bids ties up $1 million. Because the same bond cannot back multiple bids, splitting into fake identities creates no extra bidding capacity without proportional capital and its opportunity cost.
